description: Short real-run smoke for 29_ijepa: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. The port added a vit_tiny variant to models/vision_transformer.py 'so a hermetic smoke can build a tiny one', so train.name is set to vit_tiny in both stages (linear_eval must rebuild the encoder encoder.pt holds). train.img_size is 70, divisible by the patch size 14 (a 5x5 patch grid, enough for the multi-block masking); train.warmup_epochs is zeroed for the one-epoch schedule.
